sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è risk-off a causa dell'aumento del VIX (+17.59%) e della debolezza dei mercati azionari (S&P 500 -0.37%, STOXX 600 -1.15%, NIKKEI -3.55%). Il DXY è stabile (+0.15%), mentre il prezzo del petrolio è in calo (-0.40%). La BCE ha mantenuto i tassi invariati, ma la presidente Lagarde ha frenato sul rialzo dei tassi. La Fed è attesa mantenere una politica monetaria restrittiva.
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is risk-off due to the increase in VIX (+17.59%) and weakness in equity markets (S&P 500 -0.37%, STOXX 600 -1.15%, NIKKEI -3.55%). The DXY is stable (+0.15%), while oil prices are declining (-0.40%). The ECB kept rates unchanged, but President Lagarde has tempered expectations for rate hikes. The Fed is expected to maintain a restrictive monetary policy.

market_impact_summary.it: I mercati azionari sono deboli, con S&P 500 in calo dello 0.37% e STOXX 600 in calo dell'1.15%. Il VIX è in aumento del 17.59%, raggiungendo 20.32. Il DXY è stabile (+0.15%) a 101.17. Il prezzo del petrolio è in calo dello 0.40% a $77.59. La BCE ha mantenuto i tassi invariati, con il tasso di deposito al 2.00%.
market_impact_summary.en: Equity markets are weak, with S&P 500 down 0.37% and STOXX 600 down 1.15%. VIX is up 17.59% to 20.32. DXY is stable (+0.15%) at 101.17. Oil prices are down 0.40% to $77.59. ECB kept rates unchanged, with deposit rate at 2.00%.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in calo del 3.55%, Shanghai in calo dell'1.37%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura debole per i mercati europei.

nella seduta precedente, l'S&P 500 ha chiuso in calo dello 0.37%, il VIX è salito del 17.59% a 20.32, segnale di aumento dell'avversione al rischio. Il Dollar Index è in rialzo dello 0.15% a 101.17 L'oro è sceso dell'1.47% a $4120.6/oncia. Il petrolio Brent è in calo dello 0.4% a $77.59 Il rendimento del decennale USA è sceso dello 0.27% a 4.45%, mentre il BTP 10Y italiano è stabile a 3.82%.

La situazione geopolitica rimane tesa, con la questione del cessate il fuoco tra USA e Iran che continua a influenzare i mercati. Inoltre, le dichiarazioni di Christine Lagarde sulla politica monetaria europea sono state attentamente seguite dagli investitori.

Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi. Le dichiarazioni dei rappresentanti delle banche centrali, come Gabriel Makhlouf e Christine Lagarde, saranno attentamente monitorate per eventuali indicazioni sulla politica monetaria futura.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin scende del 2,82% a sessantaduemila duecentonovantuno dollari. I flussi ETF mostrano un deflusso di circa novanta milioni di dollari. Il movimento odierno potrebbe essere influenzato dalla lenta riduzione degli deflussi ETF. 

  Tra le altcoin, Ethereum perde il 5,74% a mille seicentoquarantasei dollari, Solana cede il 6,96% a sessantotto virgola settanta dollari e BNB scende del 3,23% a cinquocentosettantatré virgola quarantaquattro dollari.

  Il Fear & Greed Index è a ventitré, in zona di Extreme Fear, il che suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en:
Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. 

The Nikkei closed down 3.55%, Shanghai down 1.37%. This suggests a weak opening for European markets.

In the previous session, the S&P 500 closed down 0.37%, the VIX rose 17.59% to 20.32, a signal of increased risk aversion. The Dollar Index is up 0.15% to 101.17 Gold fell 1.47% to $4120.6/oz. Brent crude oil is down 0.4% to $77.59 The 10-year US yield fell 0.27% to 4.45%, while the Italian 10Y BTP is stable at 3.82%.

The geopolitical situation remains tense, with the US-Iran ceasefire issue continuing to influence markets. Additionally, Christine Lagarde's statements on European monetary policy were closely followed by investors.

No major macroeconomic data out today. Statements from central bank representatives, such as Gabriel Makhlouf and Christine Lagarde, will be closely monitored for any indications on future monetary policy.

Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin falls 2.82% to $62,291 ETF flows show an outflow of around $90 million. Today's movement could be influenced by the slow reduction in ETF outflows.

Among altcoins, Ethereum loses 5.74% to $1,646, Solana drops 6.96% to $68.7, and BNB falls 3.23% to $573.44

The Fear & Greed Index is at 23, in Extreme Fear territory, suggesting caution among investors.

No macroeconomic data on the agenda today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thank you for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: Will the US–Iran ceasefire hold?
articles.snippet: Will the US–Iran ceasefire hold? Expert comment jon.wallace 22 June 2026 Both sides want to buy time. But other factors like midterm elections, Israel, and deep mistrust may intervene. Since the US and Iran signed the memorandum of understanding (MOU) ending the war, much discussion has centred on the simple question of who won. There is no clear-cut answer. Washington and Israel point to the penetration of Iranian air defences, the decapitation of parts of its leadership and the damage inflicted on nuclear and military sites. Indeed, the US and Israel demonstrated that they could inflict far greater damage on Iran than Tehran could impose on them. articles.title: Is There a Place in Ukrainian Media for War Skeptics?
articles.snippet: Welcome to The Ukraine Compass, a weekly digest of Ukrainian commentary and analysis from across the political spectrum only for War on the Rocks members. Each Monday, we bring you a curated selection of articles from Ukrainian media offering insight into how Ukrainians themselves debate the issues shaping their country.American coverage often narrows the view to the battlefield — these pieces widen it, revealing the texture of daily life, politics, and public argument in a nation at war. articles.title: A Claim to Lead, a Hesitation to Act: Germany’s New Military Strategy
articles.snippet: In the public perception, it seems like a big deal for Germany to publish a military strategy for the first time. But let me pour a little cold water on that. A form of military strategy has always existed. Where today we have a National Security Strategy paired with a military strategy and Plan for the Armed Forces, the past offered the White Paper, Defence Policy Guidelines, and the Bundeswehr concept, which spelled out the armed forces’ structure in more concrete terms. articles.title: Bitcoin Price Rises Above $65,000 as ETF Outflows Slow, Iran Deal and Fed Pull in Opposite Directions
